subject.title: feat(ui): sessions sidebar redesign with agent sections, smart groups, and draft sessions

question: After the concrete blockers are repaired, should this navigation, catalog migration, and targeted session creation redesign land as one combined Control UI stack or be split into smaller changes?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and broad changes to core operator navigation, persisted catalog state, and session targeting require explicit ownership of the final product and rollout shape.

options.title: Repair as one stack
options.body: Keep the coherent workflow together, fix every blocker, and require broad exact-head upgrade and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Split the stack
options.body: Separate catalog migration, agent navigation, and targeted draft creation to reduce review and upgrade risk.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the feature if maintainers do not want to own the combined behavior change in the current cycle.

recommendation.title: Repair as one stack
recommendation.body: Keep the coherent workflow together, fix every blocker, and require broad exact-head upgrade and live behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the canonical issue, merged foundation, current-main area, and proposed UI stack, making them the strongest available decision owner.
